```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Resolve this Rmd's directory, then locate setup_publication.R from there.

  error = function(e) normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES <- c(

CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES <- unique(c(
  CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES,
  CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES
))

read_current_source <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES) {
    stop(
      "`", id, "` is not referenced by the current figures.Rmd or tables.Rmd. ",
      "Update CURRENT_REPORT_SOURCES only after the report source files change.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  read_infographic_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}

read_current_figure <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_FIGURE_SOURCES) {
    stop("`", id, "` is not a current figure source.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read_current_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}

read_current_table <- function(id, meta_id = id) {
  if (!id %in% CURRENT_TABLE_SOURCES) {
    stop("`", id, "` is not a current table source.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read_current_source(id, meta_id = meta_id)
}


# ============================================================================
# GENERIC BY-THE-NUMBERS HELPERS
# ============================================================================

info_label <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))) return("—")
  as.character(x)
}

info_cell <- function(value, label, value_type, projected = FALSE) {
  if (!is.finite(value)) return("—")

  suffix <- if (projected) "P" else ""
  paste0(format_value(value, value_type), " (", info_label(label), suffix, ")")
}

metric_values <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    first_value,
    first_label,
    last_value,
    last_label,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    projected = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID   = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section  = section,
    Measure  = measure,
    Earlier  = info_cell(first_value, first_label, value_type),
    Latest   = info_cell(last_value, last_label, value_type, projected = projected),
    Change   = format_change(first_value, last_value, change_type),
    Emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

metric_series <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    df,
    column,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    year_column = "Year",
    academic = FALSE,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    transform = identity
) {
  first <- data_endpoint(
    df,
    column,
    which = "first",
    year_column = year_column,
    academic = academic
  )

  last <- data_endpoint(
    df,
    column,
    which = "last",
    year_column = year_column,
    academic = academic
  )

  first$value <- transform(first$value)
  last$value  <- transform(last$value)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first$value,
    first_label = first$label,
    last_value = last$value,
    last_label = last$label,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

metric_snapshot <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    value,
    label,
    value_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID    = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section   = section,
    Measure   = measure,
    Earlier   = "—",
    Latest    = info_cell(value, label, value_type),
    Change    = "—",
    Emphasis  = emphasis
  )
}

metric_text <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    earlier,
    latest,
    change = "—",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tibble(
    StatID    = stat_id,
    SectionID = section_id,
    Section   = section,
    Measure   = measure,
    Earlier   = earlier,
    Latest    = latest,
    Change    = change,
    Emphasis  = emphasis
  )
}

latest_row <- function(df, year_column = "Year") {
  yr <- year_number(df[[year_column]])
  df[which.max(yr), , drop = FALSE]
}

first_last_year_labels <- function(df, year_column = "Year") {
  yrs <- year_number(df[[year_column]])
  yrs <- yrs[is.finite(yrs)]
  c(first = as.character(min(yrs)), last = as.character(max(yrs)))
}

finalize_infographic_data <- function(data, section_order) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data$Measure), nzchar(.data$Measure)) %>%
    mutate(
      Section = factor(.data$Section, levels = section_order),
      RowOrder = row_number()
    ) %>%
    arrange(.data$Section, .data$RowOrder)
}


# ============================================================================
# EDITORIAL LABEL CLEANUP
# ============================================================================
# Keep the section header responsible for the repeated concept ("international",
# "temporary visa holder share", "US universities in the global top 100", etc.)
# and keep individual measure labels short enough to scan in one line.

editorialize_infographic_data <- function(data, chapter_number) {
  out <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Section = as.character(.data$Section),
      Measure = as.character(.data$Measure)
    )

  if (chapter_number == 2) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "Where international students come from" = "Countries of origin",
          "Where international students concentrate" = "Fields and STEM concentration"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$SectionID == "origin" ~
            str_replace(.data$Measure, " share of international ", " — "),

          .data$StatID == "tab201_asia_count" ~ "Students from Asia",
          .data$StatID == "tab201_asia_share" ~ "Asia share",
          .data$StatID == "tab201_europe_share" ~ "Europe share",
          .data$StatID == "tab201_subsaharan_share" ~ "Sub-Saharan Africa share",

          .data$SectionID == "field" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, "^International students in ") ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^International students in "),

          .data$SectionID == "field" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, "^International STEM students from ") ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^International STEM students from ",
              "STEM students from "
            ),

          .data$StatID == "economic_contribution" ~
            "Contribution to the US economy",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing visa application process" ~
            "Visa application process",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing u.s. travel restrictions" ~
            "US travel restrictions",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing feeling unwelcome in the united states" ~
            "Feeling unwelcome in the US",

          .data$Measure == "Institutions citing social and political environment in the united states" ~
            "US social and political environment",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 3) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "International talent in the education-to-work pipeline" =
            "Education-to-work pipeline",
          "Which STEM graduates work in STEM" =
            "STEM graduates working in STEM",
          "Where temporary visa holders concentrate" =
            "Temporary-visa-holder share by occupation"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "pipeline_masters" ~ "Master’s students",
          .data$StatID == "pipeline_doctorate" ~ "Doctorate students",
          .data$StatID == "pipeline_opt" ~ "Optional Practical Training",

          .data$StatID == "postdoc_science" ~ "Share of science postdocs",
          .data$StatID == "postdoc_engineering" ~ "Share of engineering postdocs",
          .data$StatID == "postdoc_health" ~ "Share of health postdocs",

          .data$StatID == "stem_conversion_us" ~
            "US-born doctorate holders in STEM",
          .data$StatID == "stem_conversion_foreign" ~
            "Foreign-born doctorate holders in STEM",

          .data$SectionID == "degree_work" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, " employed in STEM occupations$"),

          .data$SectionID == "visa_concentration" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^Temporary-visa-holder share: "),

          .data$StatID == "ai_all_foreign" ~
            "All-foreign-born founder teams",
          .data$StatID == "ai_some_foreign" ~
            "Some foreign-born founders",
          .data$StatID == "founder_origin_1" ~
            "Largest immigrant-founder origin",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 4) {
    # Remove the redundant 2022 PISA-math snapshot because the time-series row
    # immediately above already ends at the same 2022 value.
    out <- out %>%
      filter(.data$StatID != "us_oecd_math") %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "Keeping STEM students in STEM" = "STEM persistence by field",
          "What Americans study abroad" = "Fields studied abroad",
          "Where Americans study abroad" = "Destinations abroad"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "us_math_gap" ~ "PISA math vs OECD average",
          .data$StatID == "us_science_gap" ~ "PISA science vs OECD average",
          .data$StatID == "us_reading_gap" ~ "PISA reading vs OECD average",
          .data$StatID == "us_top_math" ~ "Students at PISA math Levels 5–6",

          .data$StatID == "us_k12_spending" ~
            "K–12 spending and PISA math score",
          .data$StatID == "us_spending_ratio" ~
            "Tertiary-to-K–12 spending ratio",

          .data$StatID == "early_exit" ~
            "Left without return in first two years",

          .data$SectionID == "persistence" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, ": graduates remaining in entry field$"),

          .data$StatID == "tab401_stem_bachelors" ~
            "Completed a STEM bachelor’s degree",
          .data$StatID == "tab401_nonstem_bachelors" ~
            "Completed a non-STEM bachelor’s degree",
          .data$StatID == "tab401_left_no_degree" ~
            "Left with no degree",

          .data$StatID == "tab402_never" ~ "Never switched majors",
          .data$StatID == "tab402_multiple" ~
            "Switched majors more than once",

          .data$SectionID == "study_abroad" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^US study-abroad students in "),

          .data$SectionID == "study_abroad_region" ~
            str_remove(.data$Measure, "^US study-abroad students going to "),

          .data$StatID == "outbound_us" ~
            "United States — tertiary students studying abroad",
          .data$StatID == "outbound_china" ~
            "China — tertiary students studying abroad",
          .data$StatID == "outbound_india" ~
            "India — tertiary students studying abroad",
          .data$StatID == "netflow_us" ~
            "United States — net student flow (millions)",
          .data$StatID == "netflow_china" ~
            "China — net student flow (millions)",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 5) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "The institutional bench" =
            "US universities in the global top 100",
          "Patent leadership is shifting" = "Patent leadership"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "neurips_us" ~
            "US — NeurIPS oral-presentation authors",
          .data$StatID == "neurips_cn" ~
            "China — NeurIPS oral-presentation authors",
          .data$StatID == "topcited_us" ~
            "US — top-cited emerging-tech publications",
          .data$StatID == "topcited_cn" ~
            "China — top-cited emerging-tech publications",
          .data$StatID == "topauthors_us" ~
            "Top papers — US author",
          .data$StatID == "topauthors_cn" ~
            "Top papers — China-based author",
          .data$StatID == "researchers_us" ~
            "Top-1% most-cited researchers — US",
          .data$StatID == "researchers_cn" ~
            "Top-1% most-cited researchers — China",

          .data$StatID == "tab501_conference_us" ~ "Median US share",
          .data$StatID == "tab501_conference_china" ~ "Median China share",
          .data$StatID == "tab501_china_leads" ~
            "Conferences where China leads the US",

          .data$SectionID == "institutional" ~
            str_remove(
              .data$Measure,
              "^US universities in the global top 100: "
            ),

          .data$StatID == "rd_spend_us" ~
            "US spending (billions, 2020 PPP)",
          .data$StatID == "rd_spend_cn" ~
            "China spending (billions, 2020 PPP)",
          .data$StatID == "rd_intensity_us" ~ "US intensity",
          .data$StatID == "rd_intensity_cn" ~ "China intensity",

          .data$StatID == "basic_us" ~ "US basic research",
          .data$StatID == "basic_cn" ~ "China basic research",
          .data$StatID == "business_us" ~ "US business-sector R&D",
          .data$StatID == "business_cn" ~ "China business-sector R&D",

          .data$SectionID == "patents" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, "^US–China patent-grant gap: ") ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^US–China patent-grant gap: ",
              "US–China grant gap: "
            ),

          .data$SectionID == "patents" &
            str_detect(.data$Measure, " US patent grants$") ~
            paste(
              str_remove(.data$Measure, " US patent grants$"),
              "patent grants"
            ),

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  if (chapter_number == 6) {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        Section = recode(
          .data$Section,
          "Stay intentions by region of origin" = "Stay intentions by region",
          "Employment-based green-card wait times" =
            "Employment-based green-card waits"
        ),

        Measure = case_when(
          .data$StatID == "intend_stay" ~
            "PhD recipients intending to stay in the US",

          .data$SectionID == "regional_stay" ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^(.+): international STEM PhDs intending to stay in the US$",
              "\\1"
            ),

          .data$StatID == "tab602_computing" ~
            "Computer and information sciences PhDs",
          .data$StatID == "tab602_engineering" ~ "Engineering PhDs",

          .data$StatID == "tab603_tvh_academe" ~
            "Temporary visa holders — academe",
          .data$StatID == "tab603_tvh_industry" ~
            "Temporary visa holders — industry/business",
          .data$StatID == "tab603_us_industry" ~
            "US citizens — industry/business",

          .data$SectionID == "perm" ~
            str_replace(
              .data$Measure,
              "^(.+): share of PERM certifications expiring unused$",
              "\\1"
            ),

          .data$StatID == "workforce_gap_us" ~
            "US immigrant workforce-participation gap",

          .data$StatID == "trained_total" ~
            "STEM doctorate recipients in cohort",
          .data$StatID == "trained_left" ~
            "Estimated no longer in the US after ~10 years",
          .data$StatID == "training_value_left" ~
            "Estimated US training investment that left",

          TRUE ~ .data$Measure
        )
      )
  }

  out
}


export_current_chapter <- function(
    data,
    chapter_number,
    title,
    subtitle,
    name,
    source_figures,
    section_order,
    note_text = NULL,
    rows_per_page = INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE
) {
  data <- finalize_infographic_data(
    data,
    section_order
  ) %>%
    editorialize_infographic_data(chapter_number)

  build_page <- function(
      page_data,
      page_number,
      total_pages,
      is_last_page
  ) {
    final_notes <- character()

    if (is_last_page) {
      if (!is.null(note_text) && length(note_text)) {
        final_notes <- c(
          final_notes,
          note_text
        )
      }

      final_notes <- c(
        final_notes,
        paste0(
          "**Source:** Derived from the current report figures and tables: ",
          paste(source_figures, collapse = ", "),
          ". See the cited figures and tables for full source information."
        )
      )
    }

    build_infographic_table(
      data = page_data,
      id = paste0(name, "_page_", page_number),
      chapter_number = chapter_number,
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      notes = final_notes,
      layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
      row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
      nowrap_values = TRUE
    )
  }

  exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
    data = data,
    build_page = build_page,
    name = name,
    rows_per_page = rows_per_page
  )

  knitr::include_graphics(
    vapply(
      exports,
      `[[`,
      character(1),
      "png_path"
    )
  )
}
```

# Chapter 1

```{r infographic_ch1_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ============================================================================
# CHAPTER 1: AMERICA'S STEM TALENT SYSTEM — BY THE NUMBERS
#
# Design:
#   - Page 1 = historical/current U.S. pipeline measures.
#   - Page 2 = global STEM PhD projections.
#   - Both pages use exactly the same typography, columns, row heights,
#     heading treatment, and physical width.
#   - Measure labels avoid repeating words already supplied by section headers.
#
# Current report sources only:
#   Figures 1.01–1.08 and Table 1.01.
# ============================================================================


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CURRENT REPORT SOURCES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

fig101 <- read_current_figure("FIG101") %>%
  select(Year, value = 2) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

fig102 <- read_current_figure("FIG102")
fig103 <- read_current_figure("FIG103")

fig104 <- read_current_figure("FIG104") %>%
  rename(Year = 1, Total = 2, Share = 3) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

fig105 <- read_current_figure("FIG105")
fig106 <- read_current_figure("FIG106")

fig107_long <- read_current_figure("FIG107") %>%
  pivot_observed_projected()

fig108_long <- read_current_figure("FIG108") %>%
  pivot_observed_projected()

tab101 <- read_current_table("TAB101")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DERIVED STEM COMPOSITION MEASURES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These add useful chapter-level statistics without introducing any old files.
# FIG102 supplies all-degree totals; FIG103 supplies STEM-degree totals.

fig102_degree_totals <- fig102 %>%
  transmute(
    Year = year_number(.data$Year),
    All_Bachelors = numeric_clean(.data$Bachelors),
    All_Masters = numeric_clean(.data$Masters),
    All_Doctorates = numeric_clean(.data$Doctorate)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$Year))

fig103_stem_totals <- fig103 %>%
  transmute(
    Year = year_number(.data$Year),
    STEM_Bachelors = numeric_clean(.data$Bachelors),
    STEM_Masters = numeric_clean(.data$Masters),
    STEM_Doctorates = numeric_clean(.data$Doctorate)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$Year))

stem_composition <- inner_join(
  fig103_stem_totals,
  fig102_degree_totals,
  by = "Year"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_STEM = .data$STEM_Bachelors +
      .data$STEM_Masters +
      .data$STEM_Doctorates,

    Masters_Doctorate_Ratio =
      .data$STEM_Masters / .data$STEM_Doctorates,

    STEM_Share_Bachelors =
      .data$STEM_Bachelors / .data$All_Bachelors,

    STEM_Share_Masters =
      .data$STEM_Masters / .data$All_Masters,

    STEM_Share_Doctorates =
      .data$STEM_Doctorates / .data$All_Doctorates
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TABLE 1.01 FIELD SHARES — EXPLICIT 2015–2025 ENDPOINTS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

field_share_metric <- function(
    field,
    degree_prefix,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 2015L,
    latest_year = 2025L
) {
  row <- tab101 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Field) ==
        normalize_label(.env$field)
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier_col <- paste0(
    degree_prefix,
    "_",
    earlier_year
  )

  latest_col <- paste0(
    degree_prefix,
    "_",
    latest_year
  )

  required_cols <- c(
    earlier_col,
    latest_col
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(row)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required TAB101 columns for ",
      degree_prefix,
      ": ",
      paste(
        missing_cols,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "field_dependence",
    section = "International share in selected STEM fields",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = numeric_clean(
      row[[earlier_col]]
    )[[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = numeric_clean(
      row[[latest_col]]
    )[[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. PROJECTION HELPER
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

projection_metric <- function(
    df,
    country,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "count",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  country_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      is.finite(.data$value)
    )

  observed <- country_df %>%
    filter(.data$period == "Observed") %>%
    arrange(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  projected <- country_df %>%
    filter(.data$period == "Projected") %>%
    arrange(.data$Year) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  if (nrow(observed) != 1 || nrow(projected) != 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "projection",
    section = "Global STEM PhD projections",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = observed$value[[1]],
    first_label = observed$Year[[1]],
    last_value = projected$value[[1]],
    last_label = projected$Year[[1]],
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis,
    projected = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#     comparison because it is not part of the current FIG207 source file.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (

ch2_levels <- ch2_levels %>%

      ),

    ),

  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch2_india_china_grad <- ch2_fig202 %>%

  )


ch2_region_share_metric <- function(
    region_column,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  region_columns <- setdiff(
    names(ch2_tab201),
    c(
      "Year",
      "Percent Asia"
    )
  )

  tmp <- ch2_tab201 %>%
    mutate(
      Year = year_number(.data$Year),
      across(
        -Year,
        numeric_clean
      ),
      Total = rowSums(
        across(
          all_of(region_columns)
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Value = .data[[region_column]] / .data$Total
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "geography",
    section = "Geographic concentration",
    measure = measure,
    df = tmp,
    column = "Value",
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. 2025/26 ENROLLMENT PROJECTION HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The snapshot reports 2025 year-over-year changes. Apply those changes to the
# actual 2024/25 category counts to reproduce the approved 2025/26 comparison.

CH2_ENROLLMENT_2025 <- c(
  Total = 1177766,
  Undergraduate = 357231,
  Graduate = 488481,
  `Non-Degree` = 37801,
  OPT = 294253
)

ch2_snapshot_change <- function(category) {
  value <- ch2_fig206 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Category) ==
        normalize_label(.env$category)
    ) %>%
    pull(.data$Change)

  if (
    length(value) != 1 ||
    !is.finite(value[[1]])
  ) {
    stop(
      "Expected one current enrollment-change value for `",
      category,
      "`."
    )
  }

  value[[1]]
}


ch2_projection_metric <- function(
    category,
    stat_id,
    measure,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  first_value <- unname(
    CH2_ENROLLMENT_2025[[category]]
  )

  change <- ch2_snapshot_change(
    category
  )

  last_value <- first_value *
    (
      1 +
      change / 100
    )

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "economy",
    section = "Economic contribution and 2025/26 enrollment",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first_value,
    first_label = 2025,
    last_value = last_value,
    last_label = 2026,
    value_type = "count",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis,
    projected = TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. RECRUITMENT HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CH2_RECRUITMENT_2025_ALL <- bind_rows(
  ch2_fig207 %>%
    transmute(
      Rank = .data$Rank,
      Level = "Undergraduate",
      Priority = .data$Undergraduate_Country,
      Percent = .data$Undergraduate_Value
    ),
  ch2_fig207 %>%
    transmute(
      Rank = .data$Rank,
      Level = "Graduate",
      Priority = .data$Graduate_Country,
      Percent = .data$Graduate_Value
    )
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(.data$Priority),
    nzchar(trimws(.data$Priority)),
    is.finite(.data$Percent)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = 2025L
  )


ch2_recruitment_top_2025 <- function(
    level = c(
      "Undergraduate",
      "Graduate"
    )
) {
  level <- match.arg(level)

  CH2_RECRUITMENT_2025_ALL %>%
    filter(
      .data$Level == .env$level
    ) %>%
    slice_min(
      order_by = .data$Rank,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )
}


ch2_recruitment_metric <- function(
    level = c(
      "Undergraduate",
      "Graduate"
    ),
    stat_id,
    emphasis = TRUE
) {
  level <- match.arg(level)

  current <- ch2_recruitment_top_2025(
    level
  )

  baseline <- CH2_RECRUITMENT_2015_TOP

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "recruitment",
    section = "Recruitment and barriers",
    measure = paste0(
      "Top ",
      tolower(level),
      " recruitment target"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      "CN: ",
      scales::number(
        baseline$Percent[[1]],
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),
      "% (2015)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      current$Priority[[1]],
      ": ",
      scales::number(
        current$Percent[[1]],
        accuracy = 0.1
      ),
      "% (2025)"
    ),
    change = paste0(
      "CN \u2192 ",
      current$Priority[[1]]
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. BARRIER HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch2_reason_metric <- function(
    reason,
    stat_id,
    measure = reason,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch2_fig208 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Reason) ==
        normalize_label(.env$reason)
    )

  if (
    nrow(row) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  periods <- temporal_columns(
    row,
    exclude = "Reason"
  )

  values <- numeric_clean(
    unlist(
      row[periods$column],
      use.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  keep <- is.finite(values)

  periods <- periods[
    keep,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  values <- values[keep]

  if (
    length(values) == 0
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (
    length(values) == 1
  ) {
    return(
      metric_snapshot(
        stat_id = stat_id,
        section_id = "recruitment",
        section = "Recruitment and barriers",
        measure = measure,
        value = values[[1]],
        label = periods$column[[1]],
        value_type = "percent_value",
        emphasis = emphasis
      )
    )
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "recruitment",
    section = "Recruitment and barriers",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = values[[1]],
    first_label = periods$column[[1]],
    last_value = values[[length(values)]],
    last_label = periods$column[[nrow(periods)]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# 9. CODE THE ADDITIONAL TABLE 2.02–2.04 STATISTICS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These remain available in ch2_all_stats, but they are intentionally NOT in
# CH2_SELECTED_STATS because the approved example does not display them.

CH2_TAB202_FIELD_FILES <- list(
  "Engineering" = ch2_tab202a,
  "Math & Computer Science" = ch2_tab202b,
  "Physical & Life Sciences" = ch2_tab202c,
  "Business and Management" = ch2_tab202d,
  "Education" = ch2_tab202e,
  "Fine/Applied Arts" = ch2_tab202f,
  "Health Professions" = ch2_tab202g,
  "Social Sciences" = ch2_tab202h
)

CH2_TAB202_PROPORTION_FIELDS <- c(
  "Engineering",
  "Math & Computer Science",
  "Physical & Life Sciences"
)

ch2_tab202_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  CH2_TAB202_FIELD_FILES,
  function(df, field_name) {
    df %>%
      mutate(
        Year = year_number(.data$Year),
        across(
          -Year,
          numeric_clean
        )
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        -Year,
        names_to = "Country",
        values_to = "Share"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(.data$Share)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Share = if (
          field_name %in% CH2_TAB202_PROPORTION_FIELDS
        ) {
          .data$Share * 100
        } else {
          .data$Share
        },
        Field = field_name
      )
  }
)

ch2_tab202_changes <- ch2_tab202_long %>%
  group_by(
    .data$Country,
    .data$Field
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    .data$Year,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n() >= 2
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    FirstYear = first(.data$Year),
    LastYear = last(.data$Year),
    First = first(.data$Share),
    Last = last(.data$Share),
    Change = .data$Last - .data$First,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ch2_tab202_example_metric <- function(
    country,
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch2_tab202_changes %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$Field == .env$field
    )

  if (
    nrow(row) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "field_shift",
    section = "How the field mix is shifting",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      " — ",
      tolower(field)
    ),
    first_value = row$First[[1]],
    first_label = row$FirstYear[[1]],
    last_value = row$Last[[1]],
    last_label = row$LastYear[[1]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch2_grad_tvh_metric <- function(
    df,
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tmp <- df %>%
    transmute(
      Year = year_number(.data$Year),
      Temporary = numeric_clean(
        .data$`Temporary visa holders`
      ),
      Domestic = numeric_clean(
        .data$`U.S. citizens and permanent residents`
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Share = .data$Temporary /
        (
          .data$Temporary +
          .data$Domestic
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Share)
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "graduate_tvh",
    section = "Temporary-visa share of graduate enrollment",
    measure = field,
    df = tmp,
    column = "Share",
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch2_tab204b_normalized <- ch2_tab204b %>%
  rename(
    `Social Science` = any_of(
      "Social Sciences"
    )
  )

ch2_doctorate_tvh_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    display_name = field,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (
    !field %in% names(ch2_tab204a) ||
    !field %in% names(ch2_tab204b_normalized)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tmp <- inner_join(
    ch2_tab204a %>%
      transmute(
        Year = year_number(.data$Year),
        Domestic = numeric_clean(
          .data[[field]]
        )
      ),
    ch2_tab204b_normalized %>%
      transmute(
        Year = year_number(.data$Year),
        Temporary = numeric_clean(
          .data[[field]]
        )
      ),
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Share = .data$Temporary /
        (
          .data$Temporary +
          .data$Domestic
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Share)
    )

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "doctorate_tvh",
    section = "Temporary-visa share of research doctorates",
    measure = display_name,
    df = tmp,
    column = "Share",
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. BUILD AND EXPORT USING THE GLOBAL 30-ROW PAGINATION RULE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_ch2_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (is_last_page) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Academic-level rows use longitudinal bookends from the ",
        "current international-enrollment-by-level series. The 2025/26 ",
        "enrollment rows apply the reported 2025 year-over-year change to ",
        "the 2024/25 actual category count."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 2.01–2.08 and ",
        "Table 2.01, plus the report’s current international-enrollment-by-",
        "academic-level series. Historical 2015 recruitment values are from ",
        "the supplied recruitment-priorities chart."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf("%02d", page_number)
    ),
    chapter_number = 2,
    title = "WHO COMES TO THE US TO STUDY?",
    subtitle = "The changing sources of America’s international STEM talent",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest = "Latest or<br>projected value",
      Change = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}


ch2_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch2_selected,
  build_page = build_ch2_page,
  name = "infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch2_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

```{r infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ch3_degree_population_metric <- function(
    df,
    population,
    degree,
    display_degree,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!degree %in% names(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "degree_work",
    section = "From degree to STEM work",
    measure = paste0(
      population,
      " ",
      display_degree,
      " holders employed in STEM"
    ),
    df = df,
    column = degree,
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# 3. H-1B EMPLOYER SHARES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The Grand Total row is the denominator used in the current Figure 3.05,
# Figure 3.06, and Table 3.03 calculations.

  mutate(
    Company = trimws(

    )

  grepl(
    "^[0-9]{4}$",
    names(fig305)

  as.integer(ch3_h1b_year_columns) <= 2025
]

ch3_h1b_total <- fig305 %>%
  filter(
    normalize_label(.data$Company) ==
      normalize_label("Grand Total")
  ) %>%
  select(

  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),

    values_to = "Total"

  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(.data$Year),
    Total = numeric_clean(.data$Total)
  )

  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -.data$Company,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Approvals"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(.data$Year),
    Approvals = replace_na(
      numeric_clean(.data$Approvals),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ch3_h1b_total,
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Share = .data$Approvals / .data$Total
  )


ch3_h1b_top10 <- ch3_h1b_company_long %>%
  group_by(.data$Year) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = .data$Approvals,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Share = sum(
      .data$Approvals,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) /
      first(.data$Total),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ch3_h1b_company_metric <- function(
    company,
    display_name,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch3_h1b_company_long %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Company) ==
        normalize_label(.env$company),
      .data$Year %in% c(
        2017,
        2025
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(.data$Year)

  if (
    nrow(row) != 2
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "h1b",
    section = "H-1B employer concentration",
    measure = display_name,
    first_value = row$Share[[1]],
    first_label = row$Year[[1]],
    last_value = row$Share[[2]],
    last_label = row$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch3_founder_origin_metric <- function(

) {

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "ai_founders",

  )

ch3_ai_staffing_metric <- function(
    company,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- fig310 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Company) ==
        normalize_label(.env$company)
    )

  if (
    nrow(row) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "ai_staffing",
    section = "Where leading AI companies staff research",
    measure = company,
    earlier = scales::percent(
      row$`United States`[[1]],
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    latest = scales::percent(
      row$China[[1]],
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    change = scales::percent(
      row$`Rest of World`[[1]],
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. BUILD PAGES

build_ch3_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  # Page 2 is not a time comparison. Figure 3.10 is a geographic composition
  # chart, so relabel the three value columns accordingly.
  page_column_labels <- if (
    page_number == 2
  ) {
    c(
      Earlier = "United<br>States",
      Latest  = "China",
      Change  = "Rest of<br>world"
    )
  } else {
    c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest value",
      Change  = "Change"
    )
  }

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the first and latest available ",
        "observations in the current source series. H-1B company rows compare ",
        "2017 with 2025, matching current Table 3.03. Figure 3.10 rows are a ",
        "geographic composition snapshot rather than a time comparison; the ",
        "three value columns therefore report the United States, China, and ",
        "rest-of-world shares."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 3.01–3.10 and ",
        "Tables 3.01–3.03. Figure 3.06 and Table 3.03 are derived from the ",
        "same employer-level H-1B source used for Figure 3.05."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 3,
    title = "FROM EDUCATION TO THE WORKFORCE: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "International talent across research, employment, and AI",
    column_labels = page_column_labels,
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. EXPORT THROUGH THE GLOBAL 30-ROW PAGINATION RULE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch3_selected,
  build_page = build_ch3_page,
  name = "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch3_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

# Infographic audit — Chapters 1–3

```{r infographic_source_year_audit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}

# ============================================================================
# PUBLICATION QA: SOURCE + ENDPOINT-YEAR AUDIT
#
# This audit reads the actual Earlier/Latest cells that were sent to the
# infographic tables. It therefore checks what is *displayed*, not a separate
# reconstruction of the years.
#
# The CSV is always written. Set INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW <- TRUE if you also
# want the audit table printed at the end of the knitted HTML.
# ============================================================================

if (!exists("INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW")) {
  INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW <- FALSE
}


audit_extract_year <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  vapply(
    x,
    function(one) {
      if (
        is.na(one) ||
        !nzchar(trimws(one)) ||
        trimws(one) %in% c("—", "–")
      ) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }

      years <- stringr::str_extract_all(
        one,
        "(?<![0-9])(?:18|19|20|21)[0-9]{2}(?![0-9])"
      )[[1]]

      if (length(years) == 0L) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }

      tail(years, 1)
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

audit_endpoint_rule <- function(chapter, stat_id) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    chapter == "Chapter 1" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "tab101_") ~
      "Table-defined first/latest field-share endpoints",

    chapter == "Chapter 1" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "proj_") ~
      "Latest observed year → latest projected year",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "enrollment_") ~
      "2025 actual count + FIG206 year-over-year change → 2026P",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "top_recruitment_") ~
      "2015 historical recruitment baseline → 2025 FIG207 priority",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stat_id %in% c(
        "visa_application_process",
        "travel_restrictions",
        "feeling_unwelcome",
        "social_political_environment"
      ) ~
      "Earliest available survey observation → Fall 2025",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "h1b_") ~
      "2017 → 2025",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "founder_origin_") ~
      "2025 founder-origin snapshot",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(stat_id, "ai_staffing_") ~
      "Snapshot composition: US / China / rest of world; not a time comparison",

    TRUE ~
      "First nonmissing observation → latest nonmissing observation"
  )
}


audit_chapter <- function(
    data,
    chapter,
    source_map
) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      AuditOrder = dplyr::row_number(),
      Source = unname(
        source_map[
          as.character(.data$StatID)
        ]
      ),
      EarlierYear = audit_extract_year(
        .data$Earlier
      ),
      LatestYear = audit_extract_year(
        .data$Latest
      ),
      EndpointRule = audit_endpoint_rule(
        chapter,
        as.character(.data$StatID)
      ),
      Page = ceiling(
        .data$AuditOrder /
          INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE
      ),
      AuditFlag = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(.data$Source) ~
          "CHECK: source map missing",

        .data$EndpointRule !=
          "Snapshot composition: US / China / rest of world; not a time comparison" &
          .data$Earlier != "—" &
          is.na(.data$EarlierYear) ~
          "CHECK: earlier cell has no year",

        .data$EndpointRule !=
          "Snapshot composition: US / China / rest of world; not a time comparison" &
          .data$Latest != "—" &
          is.na(.data$LatestYear) ~
          "CHECK: latest cell has no year",

        !is.na(.data$EarlierYear) &
          !is.na(.data$LatestYear) &
          as.integer(.data$EarlierYear) >
            as.integer(.data$LatestYear) ~
          "CHECK: earlier year is later than latest year",

        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Chapter = chapter,
      Page = .data$Page,
      StatID = as.character(.data$StatID),
      Section = as.character(.data$Section),
      Measure = as.character(.data$Measure),
      Source = .data$Source,
      EarlierYear = .data$EarlierYear,
      LatestYear = .data$LatestYear,
      Earlier = as.character(.data$Earlier),
      Latest = as.character(.data$Latest),
      Change = as.character(.data$Change),
      EndpointRule = .data$EndpointRule,
      AuditFlag = .data$AuditFlag,
      AuditOrder = .data$AuditOrder
    )
}


infographic_source_year_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  audit_chapter(
    ch1_data,
    "Chapter 1",
    CH1_AUDIT_SOURCE
  ),
  audit_chapter(
    ch2_selected,
    "Chapter 2",
    CH2_AUDIT_SOURCE
  ),
  audit_chapter(
    ch3_selected,
    "Chapter 3",
    CH3_AUDIT_SOURCE
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    factor(
      .data$Chapter,
      levels = c(
        "Chapter 1",
        "Chapter 2",
        "Chapter 3"
      )
    ),
    .data$AuditOrder
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -.data$AuditOrder
  )

)

  infographic_source_year_audit,

)

    infographic_source_year_audit$AuditFlag
  ),

)
```
